dedupe_keys.name: usgs onshore industrial wind turbine locations march 2014

description: The US Geological Survey publishes a historical inventory of industrial-scale onshore wind turbines in the United States through March 2014. The deposit links turbine positions to wind facilities and technical specifications, compiled from public sources and checked against aerial imagery. It records confidence where a turbine could not be seen clearly or its make and model could not be established. Dryad preserves the static release as a ZIP package under CC0 1.0, allowing free access and reuse. The temporal coverage is an inventory cutoff, not a regular operational time series, and the inspected repository metadata does not state a uniform positional error. These locations can support wind-capacity siting, infrastructure exposure and historical deployment simulations, complementing data-harmonised-global-wind-solar-farm-locations-osm. A caveat is that missing specifications and uncertain imagery identifications limit detailed engineering calculations. This historical release should not be treated as a current turbine census or as a complete record of small private installations. The archive was not downloaded during this review.
